senses.gloss: m. (חֲטַר) striking with the rod, punishment.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 32a:2">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>תפיש תירוס אמתא בחד מ׳ ליהוי</he> (Ar. Var. <cite ref="M00800"><he>מחבטא</he></cite>) let the maid continue her rebellion, it will all go under one rod (in her hour of need a woman’s sins are remembered).
